## Chapter Nineteen

Critical Condition



Lucas awoke with a start in the small, damp dark room as the sound thunder rolled across the tin roof above him. His mind felt sluggish and he couldn’t move without pain radiating from sections of his body, He assumed the bullet entry points. Then he remembered Job shot me he thought his mind still processing that fact and the fact that he wasn’t dead. But if he wasn’t dead where the hell was, he. Panic began to settle in as he thought he might be back in some prison. And then Sally walked through the door, his face breaking into a smile and the relief washed over him “Guys he is awake” Sally called over his shoulder and came to sit next to the young wounded soldier. “Lucas, you’re okay, can you talk?” he prodded gently He nodded at Sally and then tried to speak, his cracked lips parted, and his mouth felt like the Sahara Desert as a croak emitted from his throat. Trying to clear it, he whispered “water” to the older man. Sally reached over and pulled a small sponge wetting Lucas’s lips and squeezing a small amount of the heavenly liquid into his mouth.

Lucas tried to cover the inside of his mouth with the cold water and it took a few more squeezes from his friend before his mouth was moist enough to be able to speak. Victoria, Emma and Rolle crowed into the small room, all smiling and looking relieved. Lucas sighed, at least they had lived, and then his face fell as he thought about the building full of innocent people, those heroes he had called them lay dead because of Job, because Job had wanted what? Money? Security? What had he said to Lucas, it wasn’t personal? Well he had another thing coming because Lucas would find him, and it would be very fucking personal when he did.

Victoria leaned down and lightly hugged him, the action causing a cascade of pain over his body and he groaned. Victoria winced and mouthed sorry as she stood back. “Hey, I need to know what happened” Sally asked, looking gravely at his friend. Lucas shook his head “It was fucking Job” he said, and everyone’s face fell. “He killed them all Sally, I couldn’t stop him, I’m so sorry, I failed” Lucas said, tears streaming from his eyes freely as his body hitched from the sorrow that rolled off his body in waves. Sally rubbed his arm “It’s okay, don’t worry” he said almost maternally to his friend.

A voice Lucas didn’t recognize bellowed from the hall “Everyone out, he needs rest” and the crowd parted for a small round Chinese woman as she walked into the room eyeing the group with mild irritation. “Sally get these people out of here now” she said, and Sally stood to protest, the little woman stood toe to toe with him and he quickly backed down, nodding and ushering the group out the door. “He needs rest, I will let you know when he is well enough to talk” she finished.

Then the little woman turned to Lucas and a smile spread across her face. “It’s good to see you awake kid” she answered with only a mild Asian accent coming through. “It was touch and go for a while” She checked the ancient looking monitors that appeared to be old digital units, Lucas wasn’t familiar with the numbers, but the Asian woman recorded them tsked at a few and seem to approve of others. “I need to check you out and then I am going to rewrap your wounds, you can call me Doctor Betty” she said and then went through a series of basic medical questions while she prodded at the wounds.

When she was done, the doctor efficiently and expertly removed the old bandages and cleaned and rewrapped the wounds. But the time she was done, he felt exhausted. The doctor Injected something into a hanging IV bag and Lucas began to fade to sleep.

He woke again sometime later and found the doctor hovering again once she noticed he was awake her face broke out into another warm smile. “good to see you awake, how do you feel” she asked gently Lucas did a quick physical and mental inventory “A little fuzzy and I ache all over” he answered shifting to find a comfortable way to lie.

Doctor Betty helped him shift and then sat in a chair next to the bed checking the bandages and IV bags. “They brought you hear about a week ago, you were in bad shape, I had to pull five bullets from your body, you had internal bleeding, but no major arteries were hit, you were lucky. I need to keep you in bed for a few more days as we pump antibiotics and saline into your body.” She finished. “Can I see my friends?” Lucas asked his voice was rough and he felt tired, but he needed to tell them what happened The doctor thought about it and then reluctantly nodded “but only for a few moments, I want you to get more sleep, you need rest if you are going to fully recover” she said her tone was disapproving but also very gently with a maternal edge. This doctor cared about her patients and Lucas felt safe here.

Doctor Betty left the room and a few moments later Sally wearing a floral pattern dress and white gloves, Rolle wore a simple T-shirt and tactical pants, both grinned ear to ear happy to see their friend alive. Looking at their faces, Lucas could imagine they had probably found him looking near death.

Sally sat next to the bed and gently laid a hand on Lucas “First, nothing was your fault, when we showed up, it, it was bad and when we finally found you, you were close to death. We rushed you here and have been trying to piece what we could together. Victoria finished going over the tape, it was forged, the person in the video wasn’t Dyson, it was Job” he said and then looked worriedly at Rolle who after a moment nodded “What, what aren’t you telling me” Lucas asked, he could see they didn’t want to tell him whatever it was, but he needed to hear it. Sally started reluctantly “I got word from the Prison, a week after you escaped, Dyson was pulled into the exercise yard and executed by government troops, we think Job turned him in” he finished , Lucas closed his eyes and said a small prayer for his friend and mentor.

When he opened them, he could see the worried look on his friend’s face, he could see what they were thinking they were second guessing there decision to tell him in his condition. “Its okay, after my conversation with Job, I had thought Dyson wasn’t long for this world” Lucas said. With a small amount of urging he told them both in detail what happened and what Job had said. When he was done Lucas could see the burning hate in both there faces “That son of a bitch, I am going to kill him” Rolle whispered. “Get in line” Sally said and somehow that simple statement sent a shiver through Lucas, something about the tone told him that if Sally did catch up to him, Job would spend many many days wishing he was dead before he eventually begged for it.

He dismissed the thought “What now?” Lucas asked, wincing as a wave of pain shot through his body. Doctor Betty peeked her head in the door and cleared her throat. Sally looked back and nodded to her. “We are going to let you get better, and then we will talk Sally said and got up.

It took another week before Lucas could get up and out of bed. Betty hovered near her patient as he took his first unsteady steps out of the room that had been his world since almost dying. He came out of the room into a large main living area, it looked like a large cabin with a small kitchen in a far corner, a dining table that sat four and a small living room area with a beat up old love seat and couch. The usual electronics and holo viewers as well as the evidence of home automation that pretty much every house came with was not present. This place was very old school and for some reason that reassured him. He nodded as he spotted Victoria and Emma working on something at the dining room table and Sally and Rolle stood up from the couch, coming over to fuss over their friend. Lucas waved them off good naturedly and tried to take a few more steps across the hand planed wood planks that made up the cabin’s floor.

After a few more steps the world turned sideways and Betty caught him, guiding Lucas to a chair and helping him sit. “Sorry” he said sheepishly to the doctor. Betty shook her head “Your right, you got shot four times, so stop being a pussy and get better” and then smiled. “relax, it takes time to heal” she said. Sitting next to him. “once you’re ready we will try a few more steps, do you feel like eating?” And just like that, Lucas realized he was famished. He could not remember the last time he had eaten anything. “We have been feeding you through the IV, so I need you to go easy, your body might be a little grumpy if you shove solid food into you with a shovel. Sally went over to the stove and after a few moments returned with a cup of chicken broth. Lucas gave him the evil eye “This doesn’t look like a steak” he said irritably, and Sally scoffed at him. Getting a spoon and laying it next to the bowl. Lucas took his time and spooned small amounts of the hot liquid into his mouth.

The next few days went like that, Lucas taking more steps and eating more food each day, until the doctor was ready to declare him mostly healed enough to walk around the house. “It’s going to be a while before he will be able to go back to any sort of full duty, but as long as he takes it easy for a couple of weeks, he is going to be fine”.

The group sat around the table with the group, everyone looked dire, Lucas could understand he felt the same way, those people had trusted them, they had pulled them out of hiding and brought them together, played by a person , they all trusted, who knew how to get everyone into a single place so that the Vipers could come in and kill , in one fell swoop the entire resistance.

As Lucas looked around the table, he saw the guilt and sorrow that he himself now struggled with. They were all that was left. This broken group was all that was left to resist a government with unlimited resources, unlimited personnel. Then Lucas felt a new feeling, hopelessness.

Sally’s shoulders slumped and he put his head into his large meaty hands, the action pulled his wig bag, he tore it off his head in frustration and flung it across the room, tears flowing from. The older man’s eyes. “We were played, I was played” he said and put his head back in his hands. “We had procedures in place, plans in place to help and protect our people it never accounted for someone with intimate knowledge of our systems to play it so well, Job hit critical safe houses, killed just enough of the network and ensured he nullified our ability to go out to the houses, forcing us to call everyone into one place, we wrapped our whole network up in a pretty bow, and because of our inability to see it, our people were slaughtered, our leader was slaughtered, all because of greed” he said spitting the last word with contempt.

Lucas didn’t know what to say, Sally was right, Job did it because he wanted an easy life and all it cost him was is soul. Victoria looked around the room “Is that it? are we out, are we going to crawl into a hole and let him win?” she asked, looking at each of her friends, her associates challenging them. “What else can we do?” Rolle asked he too looked beaten and the seed of hopelessness had sprouted in his gut, Lucas recognized it because he too had the full flower blooming in his own soul.

Everyone sat there quietly, lost in their own thoughts, they looked beaten, Job had killed not only their people, but had taken some of the spark, some of the soul from the group. “I can’t do this now” Lucas whispered getting up with a wince he walked back to his little room and sat on the edge of the bed, staring at the floor, the hatred for Job was deep, he wanted to cause him pain, he wanted to hear that man beg for his death. Lucas, for the first time wanted to use every talent that Dyson had taught him to carve into Job until he begged for mercy.

A soft knock came on the door pulling Lucas from thoughts of blood and screaming “come in” he said, as his mind played their last conversation in his head. “It’s nothing personal, it’s just business” echoed in his head over and over again. Like a jeering taunt you just can’t shake. “hey” Sally said opening the door. “How are you feeling?” Lucas looked up and gave him an odd expression. “No offense, but that is the stupidest question in the history of stupid questions” he finished and they both smiled at each other, though the smiles were tired.

Sally’s face went serious and he stepped closer to Lucas “I know why Dyson brought you in” he said. Lucas was speechless for a moment as his thoughts reeled in his head, spinning with questions and accusations and suspicions. With a breath he cleared his mind and asked the only question that he needed to know right now. “Why?”.

Sally came over and sat in the chair the doctor had used, settling back and gathering his thoughts. “Two reasons actually and both are very important.” Sitting back he assessed his friend “but before we get there, I want you to know that Job didn’t know, Dyson never told him, and damn that guy might have sensed this coming. I had instructions not to tell anyone, including Job and that I would know the right time to tell you” he said waiting for what Lucas was sure he thought would be an onslaught of accusations and suspicions. But Lucas knew Dyson, if he had a reason to keep it from everyone, he usually had a reason. Dyson his friend, his mentor, his second father, also dead , shot like a rabid dog on the side of a building. Nothing about this moral or right, the government had gone too far, finally in Lucas’s eyes, they had become evil, and evil was what you destroyed.

“I get it Sally, I knew Dyson, now what is it he had in mind for me” he answered rubbing his eyes and then looking up at his friend.

Sally sighed and collected his thoughts. “First, your father was funneling money to us, he hid that money in an account locked to your DNA, so only you can release that money, Job got the codes, he not only executed us and got paid for it, but walked away with all of our financial resources, but you can change that for, there is a sizeable amount that can allow us to operate, or disappear , whichever we decide” Lucas nodded, he had assumed that his role had something to do with his father and his actions , the actions that had gotten him killed.

But was there more? What could the second reason be he wondered and looked back up at his friend. He first thought about what he wanted to do and Lucas knew , he didn’t want to run, he didn’t want to slink away like a beaten dog and hide, he wanted to destroy those who had executed those innocent and brave people in that lonely building, and he would start with Job, but for that he would need help and he knew it , there was no way he could do this alone. “We will take a vote, whichever we decide to do, I will release the funds to you so that we can make that happen” He finished and Lucas could see the relief on Sally’s face.

For a moment he was a little offended, did Sally think he would run off with it, take the money and leave his friends hanging in the wind. He calmed himself , a lot had happened if there were irrational suspicions he would allow them, because he understood. “What’s the second reason?” he asked and watched as Sally shifted uncomfortably. “That’s a little more complicated, and I am not sure If the story is true” he said prefacing his next statements. This peaked Lucas’s interest, what the hell was this about he wondered.

Sally settled back looking at the floor and organizing his thoughts for a moment, Lucas waited patiently.

In the last century before the government was brought down and before the plague, the United States had been attacked more than once and had concerns about biological and nuclear attacks from extremists, so bunkers were updated and new ones built that gave important scientists and pre-selected powerful individual’s the ability to enter these bunkers and find solutions or to find or to maintain continuity of government. These bunkers were stocked, they had supplies, weapons and information.”

He began, ensuring that Lucas was able to keep up with him. Lucas nodded “I took history, the so called Wolf bunkers, used by small groups of problem solvers and decision makers to ensure that our country was saved and we were able to solve problems while those on the surface suffered in chaos, yeah they were myths” Lucas finished with a wave of his hand.

Sally nodded “that’s what I thought too, and though the information is spotty, Dyson believed them to exist however they are locked by a genetic lock, only those with the right genetic fingerprint can enter and gain control of one of these bunkers, according to the rest of the story when the bio-plague hit, it had already infected enough of the population after two years incubation that the bunkers were useless, everyone was infected, so when half the population died, they were forgotten, lost in the chaos of trying to rebuild” Sally continued and now Lucas was lost. “Okay, so anyone who could access one of these is dead, what does that have to do with me?” Lucas mused

Sally made a wait motion and walked out into the main room leaving Lucas for a moment, when he returned, he carried an old cracked and yellowing folder. Sitting down he gently opened it. Handing Lucas an old yellow sheet of paper “Meet Colonel Joseph Christian, your great grandfather and commanding officer of Bunker theta” he said holding out the piece of paper. Lucas looked at the paper with the faded text he could barely read. He tried to make sense of the data on the page and couldn’t. “Okay, ill bite what does this mean?” Sally had waited for the question and smiled. Leaning forward almost conspiratorially “Alone, nothing but Emma has a device that could crack a genetic lock as long as a piece of the original DNA can be found, which a piece of his DNA exists in you, second Dyson sent me a map a year ago” Sally pulled another folded piece of paper from the folder and gently handed it to Lucas. Again he opened and looked, on the paper in what looked like the middle of nowhere was the letter x written in red and above it , was the word “theta”. Now Sally had his interest peaked. “Okay, are you saying we know where the bunker is and we can get into it?” he asked Sally seeing the interesting and smiling. “Yes, and Yes, now we don’t know what exactly is in it, but worst case it’s a base to operate from, best case there is equipment in there we can use” he finished.

Lucas nodded, “well we need to find out what the others think then.” Thirty minutes later the entire group sat around the table as Sally relayed the information everyone was engrossed by the tail. “But first, we need to know what everyone wants to do” he started continuing to look around the table and making eye contact with each of them

“We can run, disappear, there is enough money for each one of us to start a new life in some other country, or we can gather our resources and take the fight to them, we might not live, but we will deal a blow to the people who killed our friends” Sally finished.

Everyone was silent, not a word was spoken as each person reflected on their choices. Lucas leaned forward now, taking over for Sally “We cannot do it without each one of us here at this table, so unless we vote unanimously, then we run and never look back” he said, no one made eye contact with him at the thought of that. “Who is with me, I want to fight these fuckers, they deserve to bleed for what they did to our friends” he said and raised his hand. Sally also did as well as Rolle, the two girls looked at each other for a long moment and then with a solem nod, they too raised their hand. “Oh hell, I’m in” came a voice from the kitchen as the doc brewed coffee. Sally gave her an arched eyebrow “Who made you part of this?” he scoffed, and the doctor moved with speed and grace right up into Sally’s face. “Listen here you old queen, unless you guys suddenly developed the skills to operate on a gunshot wound then you are going to need me got it bub” the much shorter Asian woman said practically nose to nose with Sally. Lucas suppressed a smile “She can come” he said and caught a dirty look from Sally. “Oh, aren’t we lowering our standards” he whispered after the Doc had returned to the kitchen. “I heard that” she yelled flipping Sally off.

Armed with shopping lists Sally gave Victoria the last of the cash and sent them out for supplies. Rolle, Sally and Lucas gathered the gear and packed up for the trip, they had a long road ahead of them and still a lot to do.

After the women had returned, they had locked themselves into Lucas recovery room until almost midnight, when they came out Emma was carrying a modified holo system. “This will allow us to connect to the gov.net, but also keep Cerberus out temporarily, we need to get into the net banking system to transfer the funds out of the locked account your dad setup and into new accounts accessible by  a set of blind codes. We will also be loading blind discs” Lucas nodded, blind discs were small digital wallets allowing you to carry anonymous electronic currency this would allow them to pay for things completely anonymously as not to leave a trail.

Victoria started the system and a menu floated above the holo system as she booted the other shadow boxes and setup the secure connection. “We have a limited amount of time, I have setup the accounts” She finished as her hands waved over the menu opening terminals and with a speed and expertise that Lucas couldn’t begin to understand Victoria setup the software firewalls and encryption systems that would keep them temporarily from being tracked.

On the table were a series of metal rectangles, the physical digital wallets, Lucas had seen them before. All connected up to the computer. Once she was ready, Victoria turned to the group. “Now we are only going to have moments to get this done, I am sure as soon as we push Lucas’s genetic code Cerberus will lock onto it and try and trace our system back to its source. I am bouncing the signal all over the world and I have multiple redundant firewalls, we will have one chance to do this, Cerberus is a learning system if we don’t get it this time, it will be ready for us next time” she finished, making the computer system that was the governments backbone security system sound like an actual stalking monster then just a set of ones and zeroes.

Emma nodded and Victoria began to run her systems as the holo viewer connected to the net and navigated to the banking hub. “Lay your hand on the pad” Victoria told Lucas pointing at a small black plate of metal that suddenly illuminated red. He laid his hand and a moment later the color of the light changed to green.  “shit, its locked on” Emma said watching a small old school screen. “It’s through the first connection node” she said, and Victoria hissed, her hands moving faster as she authenticated the account and opened the banking transfer systems. “It’s through the Chinese nodes, now the Brazilian nodes, its dropped both Canada and Mexico, you need to hurry” Emma urged her eyes wide as she stared at the information in front of her. Victoria cursed as she backed out of a menu and into another, then another with a smile she said “Starting transfers” and a progress bar came up, floating above the table as the bank logo spun the number crawled up towards one hundred.

“Its found our connection node, its now hitting the firewalls.” Emma said her tone becoming urgent. Victoria tapped her fingers against the table nervously, everyone willing the progress bar to speed up, to finish as fast as possible. Lucas watched as the lights on the electronic wallets began to blink, as transfers to the devices began. “It’s tore through the first two hardware firewalls” Emma said, and Lucas looked at the first two of the ten boxes on the edge of the table, the lights had turned red, but continued to blink. He could feel himself beginning to sweat as he went back to urging the progress bar to finish. “Two more firewalls hosed” Emma said and sure enough two more boxes lights had turned red.

The progress bar crawled upward seeming to slow down, Lucas couldn’t tell whether it actually was slowing or only their perception of it. “four more down” Emma said now her tone sounding panicked. And as Lucas looked the last two boxes were the only ones showing green lights. “One firewall left, kill the connection” Emma almost yelled “NO” Victoria screamed leaning forward on the table. Lucas watched the last box, willing it to hold out, willing it to keep them safe. The progress bar finished, and Victoria dove for the connection wire, ripping it out of the computer. Lucas had been watching the last firewall box and he thought it had turned red just before Victoria had disconnected it. “We need to go now” Lucas said, “They might know where we are”. At that everyon scrambled to pack up what gear they were taken and load up the old unmarked ambulance outside that the doctor kept as her vehicle.

Everyone piled in as the doctor began to ascend the old ambulance towards the sky. “Victoria and Emma were whispering urgently to each other. “Do you want to share with the entire class” Sally asked annoyed. Victoria turned and faced them “They might have learned our location, but our data remained secure, so we completed the transfers without being traced she finished and handed a piece of paper to Sally. He quickly looked at it and tore it in two. Handing one to Lucas “These are the codes to access the financial resources of what remains of the underground, it now takes the two of us in order to transfer substantial sums” he finished, and in one fell swoop Sally had named his successor and second in command.

As the bus reached the Skyway and entered traffic. Lucas watched as four sets of lights rapidly descended towards the small cabin. “That was a little too close” he whispered to the window. Then they were gone, just another anonymous vehicle on the road at night. As they drove Sally moved up to the passenger seat and began to give directions to the doctor. While he did this Victoria handed each one of the e-wallets “These have a decent amount of credits, use this to buy essentials or other items you need, one they are expended please return them and we can refill them.” She said. Lucas took his and slipped it into a pocket on his pants.

The group rode in silence, all reflecting on what had just happened or what they were about to do.
